A '''giant bird''' was found on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was resting on top of a cliff, until it was disturbed by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] as he attempted to use a [[Lasso/Legends|lasso]] to swing across the cliff, but the rope got caught around the bird’s lower body, causing it to angrily squawk and fly into the air, with Teebo still holding onto the rope before he fell to the ground.<ref name="2-12" />

==Behind the scenes==
The giant bird appeared in the season two ''[[Ewoks (television series)|Ewoks]]'' episode "A Warrior and a Lurdo".<ref name="2-12" />
